name: Tampered router port
description: Physical tampering with network equipment to create a backdoor.

name: ARP Spoofing
description: Poison ARP cache, intercept traffic on link-layer.

name: IP Spoofing / Route Manipulation
description: Manipulating routing so traffic is sent to attacker.

name: SYN Flood
description: Transport-level DoS by exhausting connection queue.

name: Session Hijacking
description: Steal/reuse session tokens to impersonate legitimate user.

name: SQL Injection
description: Application-level injection allowing data exfiltration or modification.
